_about: Chain 35's half read, second run (17 Oct 2026): chain 35h trained its 'analytic' arm with 44 analytic labels because its fetch failed silently (rsync missing in Git Bash), so it was not the registered half read and its models are invalid. Same registration (design note Design_2026-10-05_Analytic_Labels_and_Stepping_Stone.md, amendment 8 Oct 07:2x): chain 34's recipe (v1.1, 750, three seeds) on one pool, trained with the analytic labels of the smallest half against the same pool trained with FD labels; evaluation on analytic labels for both. It MEASURES and does not judge. Guard: a family other than 'other' worse than its seed range means the pipeline (substitution, loader count) is checked. New: the fetch refuses a partial copy, and the training is refused unless ≥ 413 molecules of ≤ 22 atoms carry both analytic Hessians.
